example_sentences_in_bangla: সে উঁচকপালে বলে সবসময় ভাগ্যবান হয়ে যায়।
উঁচকপালে লোকেরা জীবনে সহজেই সফল হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is considered উঁচকপালে, so he always turns out lucky.
People with a high forehead are believed to be fortunate in life.
history: This idiom stems from traditional Bengali physiognomy beliefs where physical features like a high forehead are thought to indicate good fortune, rooted in folk superstitions rather than documented history.
note: The belief is based on popular cultural perception without strong historical or religious ties.
